---
title: "Running Scenarios"
---

`run_scenarios` takes a list of settings and campaigns and returns one row for each. It derives
`dn0` from the net mix and the resistance level, inverts whatever transmission measure was
supplied into an EIR, applies any mosquito-density adjustment, assembles the twelve covariates,
and runs the emulator over the 157-window grid. One call does all of it. Scalar summaries and
full trajectories come back side by side.

`run_scenarios` is exported from `estimint` but drives both packages. The inversion is done by
estiMINT's XGBoost models and the trajectories by stateMINT's Mamba2 emulator, and nothing is
imported from `stateMINT` directly.

::: {.chapter-outline}
- [Running scenarios](run-scenarios.qmd)
    - The `Scenario` and `EirTarget` fields, and every column that comes back.
- [A scenario grid](scenario-grid.qmd)
    - Five campaigns run against one shared baseline.
- [Trajectories and cases](comparing.qmd)
    - Prevalence, clinical incidence, and the burden each campaign averts.
- [Exporting results](exporting.qmd)
    - Scalar summaries to CSV, trajectories to a tidy table R can read.
:::

Two ways of driving the API run through the pages that follow. The first varies every axis at
once, with all three input modes, all four net products, both seasonality settings, and
mosquito-density adjustments in either direction. The second holds one setting fixed and varies
only the campaign, so any difference between the rows is caused by the campaign and nothing
else. That setting is under-5 prevalence 0.45, pyrethroid resistance 0.30, pyrethroid-only nets
at 0.70 coverage, `Q0 = 0.85`, `phi_bednets = 0.80`, perennial transmission, and neither IRS nor
LSM in place. It is the same district throughout.
